name: TOB Verse Background
description: Background pictures for the Verse of the Day popup and wallpapers. Each row keeps the image and the prompt that made it, so a lost or worn-out picture can be made again in the same style. A row with a prompt but no image is an idea for a future picture: generate it from the prompt, attach the image and set Status to Active. Portrait 9:19.5 (e.g. 1024×1536 or larger); the app crops it to the phone and dims it under the verse.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Idea = prompt only, no picture yet. Active = used by the app. Retired = kept for the record, not used.

fields.label: Shows Jesus
fields.description: The picture shows Jesus (otherwise a landscape). Lets the app mix them, e.g. Jesus on Sundays.
